Question: ASalamulika, Dear Molavi Sahib,I love to ask my question in Urdu, but unfortunetaly I don't speak Urdu, the question is, for example Ahmad is the son of Mahmmod, Mahmmod is very rich person, and Ahmad is also living with Mahmmod, but does not have any authorization in his father Affluence, his father Mahmmod feed his son, but does not take care of Ahmad's Children excpet for food and housing, though Ahmad also needs money for his children and wife expenses. now can we give Zakat to Ahmad? is his father's money his? I hope you understand my question. and your quick reply will be highly appreciated. Wasalam! Answer ID: 15985 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1438/1155=L=1430) After maturity, a boy becomes independent, thus a son who does not have resources will not be considered rich if his father is wealthy. You can give him Zakah if he deserves to receive it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
